findings.title: Closed slots are distinguishable by color only (마감 cannot be read without color)
steps: Compare closed slots 11:00 / 13:00 / 15:00 with available slots 10:30 / 13:30 / 14:00 / 15:30
findings.expected: Closed slots carry a non-color cue so 마감 is understandable without color (the case-4 variant adds '마감' text)
findings.observed: Closed slots render only the time text (e.g. '11:00', enabled:false) with red styling; the legend '예약 가능 / 마감' uses color dots only; no text cue on the slots themselves

findings.title: Validation error is not tied to the phone field (AT users get no field-level error context)
findings.state: After submitting with the phone number omitted
steps: Tap 예약 신청하기 without 휴대폰 번호
findings.expected: The invalid field is programmatically flagged (aria-invalid / described-by) and receives focus
findings.observed: Error text appears only in the top alert banner ('입력 내용을 확인해 주세요. 휴대폰 번호를 정확히 입력해 주세요.'); #phone keeps invalid:false with no aria-describedby and no error association; focus stays on the 예약 신청하기 button

findings.title: Error banner persists after the phone number is corrected (looks like the fix was not accepted)
findings.state: After correcting the phone number, before resubmit
findings.expected: The error indication clears or updates when the field is corrected
findings.observed: The banner stays visible with the same message while the corrected value is in the field; it is hidden only in the completion state after a successful resubmit

findings.title: Closed slots are reported focusable although disabled (keyboard dead stops)
steps: Compare a11y metadata of closed slots between variants
findings.expected: Disabled slots are not in the keyboard tab order
findings.observed: Closed slots are enabled:false but reported focusable:true (case-4 reports focusable:false); keyboard walk was not run (--no-focus-walk), so tab behavior is inferred from metadata

limitations: Single run; tap on a closed slot was not exercised in this case (exercised in case-4: no feedback, no selection).
Keyboard tab order not walked (--no-focus-walk); closed-slot focusability rests on recorded metadata.
Blur-triggered error clearing not tested; clearing observed only across resubmit.

findings.title: Completion screen does not take focus (keyboard users stay on covered content)
steps: Check focus and layers in the completion snapshot
findings.expected: Focus moves into the completion state, or the covered page becomes inert
findings.observed: The full-screen result sheet (role=status) shows 주문번호 and 결제 수단, but contains_focus:false and focus stays on the page body; focus is not directed to the result state

limitations: Single run; focus behavior read from snapshot fields only (no keyboard walk).
Coupon 받기 flow was not exercised (task only required closing the banner).

findings.title: Error state stays red/aria-invalid after correction (user may think the value is still wrong)
findings.state: After correcting the phone number, before resubmit
steps: Submit without phone (inline error + bottom banner appear)
findings.expected: The error state clears or updates when the field becomes valid
findings.observed: Red border (#b3261e), inline '⚠ 휴대폰 번호를 정확히 입력해 주세요. 예: 010-1234-5678', the bottom banner, and aria-invalid="true" all persist on the corrected field; they clear only after a successful resubmit

findings.title: Focus stays on submit after a failed submit (keyboard users must navigate back to the error)
findings.expected: Focus moves to the first invalid field (휴대폰 번호)

limitations: Single run; error clearing on blur or on input event not tested — only the resubmit path was observed.

findings.title: Banner close target is 16×16 px (hard to tap; mis-tap risk near 받기)
steps: Open the cart with the coupon banner
findings.expected: Touch target at least 24×24 CSS px (ideally 44×44)
findings.observed: #promo-close is 16×16 CSS px at the banner corner (x=318, y=86); the equivalent control in the case-2 variant is 44×44

findings.title: Payment tap shows no acknowledgment for ~2.6 s (repeat-tap risk)
steps: Read the first feedback latency from run.json
findings.expected: Immediate visible acknowledgment (e.g. a '결제 처리 중…' state) after the tap
findings.observed: First feedback recorded at 2615.4 ms (the completion sheet); the button text stayed '143,900원 결제하기' with no processing or disabled state; the case-2 variant shows '결제 처리 중…' with ~12 ms feedback

findings.title: 전체삭제 sits next to the payment CTA (fat-finger cart loss risk)
steps: View the sticky footer on the cart screen
findings.expected: Destructive actions are separated from the primary payment action
findings.observed: '전체삭제' (84×52 px) sits directly left of '143,900원 결제하기' (240×52 px) in the same footer row; the case-2 variant places 전체 삭제 in the header instead; no mis-tap was reproduced and confirmation behavior was not tested

findings.title: Completion screen does not take focus (keyboard users stay on covered content)
findings.expected: Focus moves into the completion state
findings.observed: Result sheet shown while focus remains on the covered #pay button (contains_focus:false)

limitations: Single run; double-tap during the ~2.6 s no-feedback window was not tested.
전체삭제 confirmation behavior was not exercised.
Focus behavior read from snapshot fields only (no keyboard walk).

overall_limitations: Single controlled run per case (operator C); no repeats and no other operators' data.
Transport options --no-focus-walk and --no-reflow: keyboard tab-order walks and 320px reflow were not measured; keyboard items rest on recorded a11y metadata and focus fields.
Chromium emulation of galaxy-s24 (360x780 CSS, DPR 3, touch) only; no real device, WebKit, screen reader, or on-screen keyboard.
Per the brief, page source/JS, scenario JSON, and other operators' outputs were not read; state was observed only through the provided snapshot/inspect interface and screenshots.
All pages are offline synthetic fixtures; local submit/pay actions are synthetic; task success is the driver-measured criterion (completion selector visible), not real-world booking or payment.
An initial sandbox-blocked Chromium launch for case-3 was rerun with elevated permissions; no case was marked failed for environment reasons.
Run order: case-3, case-2, case-4, case-1. Timing values are driver-measured feedback latencies from run.json.
Budget closeout: the 25-minute execution budget expired after all four cases had finished; this file uses only evidence obtained during the runs.
